RallyHer Contributor * # Elise Mertens Is Playing the Best Tennis of Her Life and Swiatek Cannot Find a Way Through Image: Elise Mertens celebrates after defeating Iga Swiatek to reach the semifinals of the 2026 China Open Spencer Cashmill · October 9, 2026 Elise Mertens vs. Iga Swiatek — China Open 2026 Quarterfinal Match Report At 30, Elise Mertens looks as if someone has turned every part of her game up by 10 percent. The serve is heavier. The returning is sharper. The forehand down the line is arriving with more conviction. The defensive backhand is absorbing everything. Even the improvised shots, including some extraordinary lobs, are landing. Coco Gauff discovered all of that in the previous round. Now Iga Swiatek has as well. Mertens defeated the Pole 7-6(0), 6-3 to reach the China Open semifinals, producing a remarkable 7-0 tiebreak shutout before finding the only break she needed in the second set. Swiatek stayed close almost throughout. She simply could not hit through the Belgian’s confidence. ## Beijing Is Not Getting Any Easier Mertens has now taken out Coco Gauff and Iga Swiatek in consecutive rounds. That alone tells the story of where her tennis currently stands. At 30, she is not merely enjoying a late-career run. She is playing with a level of assurance that makes familiar strengths look newly dangerous. Unfortunately for her, Beijing has no interest in offering an easier next assignment. Qinwen Zheng awaits in the semifinal, with the home favorite carrying an increasingly loud Chinese crowd behind her. Elise Mertens has already gone through two of the biggest names in the draw. To reach the final, she will now have to quiet Beijing itself. If her serve is firing again, it is possible.
